items.summary: The Karnataka government recently reconstituted lawyers' panels tasked with handling sensitive and communal cases arising within the jurisdiction of Mangaluru City Police Commissionerate and Dakshina Kannada District Police Unit before the Karnataka High Court. The Home Department issued two orders on November 7, superseding an earlier order dated July 3, 2025, which had constituted the panels. The decision to reconstitute the panels was taken following a request from the Advocate General's Office, which pointed out that some of the law officers appointed under the earlier panels were no longer working in the office. This had affected the effective conduct of cases before the High Court. The government, after consultation with the Advocate General for Karnataka, decided to reconstitute the panels to ensure effective representation in all sensitive and communal cases arising within the respective police jurisdictions.
